data.long_meaning: Anav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anava', which means 'one who is merciful and graceful'. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. The name Anav signifies humility, selflessness, and compassion. The name Anav carries the meaning “Graceful, merciful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anav usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
